subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only three people sit between R and Q when counted from the left of R. Only three people sit between V and U when counted from the right of U. S sits to the immediate right of V. T is an immediate neighbour of U as well as Q. How many people sit between T and P when counted from the right of P?
solution: Given: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Only three people sit between R and Q when counted from the left of R. 2) T is an immediate neighbour of U as well as Q.
